A '''laser skiff''' was a vehicle used to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in [[the Graveyard]]. They could move at 130 kmh. Each was equipped with a mining [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].
